core_obligations: Set up the dual (proof lines 8914-8922): the author introduces the contragredient module M^vee and uses finite projectivity of M over R to identify the internal hom of M with the tensor product M^vee tensor N.

Compare the resolutions (proof lines 8922-8932): the standard resolution computing group cohomology of the tensor product gives the right hand side, while the Ext groups of R-G-modules are computed from a resolution of M whose finite projectivity over R allows the comparison.
Conclude (proof lines 8932-8938): the two computations agree, which is the asserted identification.
proof_roadmap: Introduce the contragredient module and use finite projectivity over R.
Compare the resolution computing group cohomology with the one computing Ext of R-G-modules.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the Ext groups of R-G-modules with the group cohomology of the tensor product of the contragredient module with the coefficients, when the first variable is finite projective over R (statement lines 8905-8912). The proof introduces the contragredient module and uses finite projectivity to replace the internal hom by a tensor product (proof lines 8914-8922), compares the two resolutions computing the two sides (proof lines 8922-8932) and concludes the identification (proof lines 8932-8938). The non-formal content is the comparison of the resolutions, which is where finite projectivity is used. The claim is H2: one comparison of resolutions.
